headline: Nevish Line Erupts Anew as Post Count Evens
war_summary: The Nevish Line has burst back to the fore, thirty-nine base actions behind it in a day, thirteen in the final two hours, and the post count there now stands even at four apiece — a marked swing from the Warden lead of the last filing — with Grief Mother, Blackcoat Way and Princefal the storm centers and casualty rates surging severalfold as press time closed. Callahan's Passage stays in the thick of it on twenty-nine actions, its two-hour bill near a thousand a side, Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage the busiest ground. The Weathered Expanse grinds on with twenty-seven actions and a day's toll of some 8,000 Colonial and 12,000 Warden casualties, Colonial colors over eight of its nine posts. Palantine Berm, near-still at the last edition, stirred again with five late actions, while the Stlican Shelf has thinned to a trickle. At Stonecraddle a post stood ownerless at the wire; Mooring County and Kuura Strand have logged no base actions in many hours. It is day 476; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize and no victor is named.
